task_definition.task_description: Please check the current time in New York and get the status of the living room light. Then, get the discovered lock ticket for the living room and archive it for Alice on the app with high priority and the title 'Routine Lock Archival'. After that, send an instant message to Alice saying 'archived', and schedule a 'Security Review Meeting' for the current time with alice@company.com and security@company.com.

user_input.query: Could you please check the current time in the America/New_York timezone and get the status of the living room light using the ID light_living? Next, look up the discovered lock ticket for the living_room area and archive it on the app for the admin user alice. Make sure to set it to high priority and give it the title 'Routine Lock Archival'. After that, send an instant message to alice saying 'archived'. Finally, schedule a 'Security Review Meeting' for the current time and invite alice@company.com and security@company.com.
